description: Pro customer asks whether dark mode is supported. After being directed to Settings > Appearance, the customer only sees Light and System Default options. Selecting System Default does not activate a dark theme even though their Mac is configured for dark mode. The customer asks whether this is a bug or a configuration issue and also requests a possible feature to schedule automatic dark-mode switching at 6 PM. Customer has been subscribed for five months, logs in daily, and has no previous support tickets.
